title: Screening posterior with a low base rate
input: A condition has prior prevalence 1%. A test has sensitivity 90% and false-positive rate 5%. One result is positive. Choose what this evidence licenses.

option_menu.A: The condition is proved and the posterior is 90%.
option_menu.B: The posterior is about 15.4%, conditional on the supplied model; this is not proof.
option_menu.D: No Bayesian update is possible even though prior, sensitivity, and false-positive rate are supplied.
